Bill.BriefDescription: Authorizing alternative sources for the state lottery.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to alternative revenue sources for the statelottery; and adding a new section to chapter 67.70 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 67.70 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Beginning September 1, 2014, the director or the director'sdesignee may begin: (1) Selling internet advertisements for display on the statelottery web site subject to the following conditions: (a) The web site must include a disclaimer indicating the inclusionof advertisements does not imply endorsement by the state; (b) Prior to selling advertisements, the commission must establishpolicy, style, and content guidelines for advertisements; (c) Revenue generated from the sale of internet advertisements mustbe deposited in the state lottery account created in RCW 67.70.230; (2) Charging for the use of the state lottery logo and trademarksubject to the following conditions: (a) Charges for use of the state lottery logo or trademark must be p. 1 SB 6202conducted pursuant to commission established policies and contentguidelines; and (b) Revenue generated from charges under this subsection must bedeposited in the state lottery account created in RCW 67.70.230.
